# Gramlot 0.3.24

Consolidates the common release base: Source/Data-owned form and index state, dbSelect conditions and weak conditions, native device integration, chat, Grouplets, and the expanded Grid runtime.

Environment Page classes provide their included collections to page authors. External editor and rendering engines load on demand. Resident Grids virtualize their DOM while retaining records in Data; column and row geometry, gutter sizing and scrolling remain stable. The packaged experimental selection_trial collection supports typed JSONL loading and Asqueel cached-window examples.

JSONL/window selection remains an experimental integration, not the final dataSelection/dbQuery contract. Those designs and database-managed permission proposals are documentation only. Invoice application, Python compiled-page export and bundle deduplication are not included.
